_about: Shared payment forms, committed: each gateway's sandbox TEST card and, when auto-detect needs help, recipe steps. Read by config/paymentForms.js on every run (no restart). A gateway's entry in data/gateways.json -> paymentForms (local, git-ignored) overrides it. Sandbox test cards only — never a real card. Format: developer-docs/gateways/recipes.mdx and test-cards.mdx.

ReservePay._notes: Hosted checkout on flow.reservepay.com; the card form is in an iframe from sdk.reservepay.com ('Cards' is pre-selected). After paying, ReservePay stays on its own 'Payment successful' page until 'Back to Paylexer' is clicked — auto-detect does that. THB only. The card below (generic sandbox Visa) is confirmed: ReservePay on WPTE passed with it on 2026-10-08 (RUN-20261008-001-1523, Live PayLexer, ReservePay test account). More cards (decline, 3-D Secure) come from the ReservePay dashboard's test card generator.

GalaxyPay._notes: Hosted card page on uat-paymentv2.galaxypay.vn (card number, cardholder name, 'Valid through' MM/YY, CVV; pay button 'Continue Payment'). After paying, the UAT sandbox redirects to its own demo merchant at uat-demo.galaxypay.vn instead of the store's Thank You page, so reaching that URL counts as the pass (successUrl). Galaxy Pay only.
